vo.text: JaiSathya is a holding company with eight businesses, from restaurants to a cricket club, and every copy change used to need a developer.
So I built a site where the client edits the page itself.

items.title: Publish
items.sub: copies draft → published, in one write

vo.text: In the admin, the client edits text and images directly on the real page layout, and picks images from a Cloudinary media library.
Edits save as a draft, and visitors only see them when the client publishes.
Under the hood, every editable thing is a row in one documents table, with draft and published JSON side by side, on Neon Postgres with Drizzle.
The editor builds its form from whatever shape the document has, so adding a field never needs a migration.
